about_the_game:
Nothing But Road is a cozy post-apocalyptic road trip with light survival elements and a soul.
There are no enemies. No zombies. No bandits. Just you, your car, and the unknown.

Explore procedurally generated wilderness segments between story-rich destinations. Loot abandoned cabins, repair your vehicle, upgrade it with survival modules, and keep moving forward — because something dark is slowly catching up behind you.

Your car is your lifeline — your best friend. Equip it with extra fuel tanks, storage units, food preservation tools, and tracking devices to help you scavenge deeper into the unknown.

Key Features:

  • Atmospheric third-person exploration with stylized low-poly visuals

  • A gentle yet emotional solo journey about hope and isolation

  • Partial open world: freedom to explore each zone before driving onward

  • A light crafting system and satisfying loot mechanics

  • Story Mode (approx. 5+ hours planned) and Endless Infinity Mode with unique content

  • No combat. Just survival, exploration, and your bond with the road.

Whether you’re a fan of slow-paced survival, cozy indies, or reflective adventures — this is a game made to be felt, not rushed.
